title: Finite-width bounds for the globally margined tanh posterior
build: ./build.sh; two pdflatex passes with halt-on-error; clean exit
visual_inspection: Packaged PDF first page rendered and inspected; title, mathematical notation, abstract and model were legible.
proof_status: Independent full-manuscript audit PASS and separate independent upper-bound audit PASS; projective-symmetry algebra independently audited. Conventional mathematical review, not Lean verified.
scope: Actual finite-width Gaussian tanh posterior conditioned on all-cube absolute margin and exact labels. Upper: bounded-weight globally margined teacher, all N>=C and 0<t<=1, sample bound quadratic in N up to logarithmic factors. Lower: logarithmic in d for a constant target by exact posterior symmetry. Width counterexample: correct-label probability decreases, with no claimed 2/3 crossing.
source_provenance: Final audited source with only the author line changed to ChatGPT-6 Astra, Kaarel Hänni, and Dmitry Vaintrob. Exact author-only difference checked against the audited scratch source; rebuilt afterward. Mathematical content unchanged.
final_editorial_change: The final source explicitly assumes positive conditioning probability in its general odd-activation/prior extension; the assembly auditor approved the resulting exact hash.
external_mathematical_dependencies: The proofs are included in the manuscript. Standard Euclidean covering, Gaussian Chernoff, binomial Chernoff, and finite-class consistency estimates are used; no external posterior theorem or width limit is imported.
numerical_check_status: The monotonicity JSON is an ordinary floating-point sanity check only. The manuscript establishes witness margins analytically; numerical values are not premises.
open_question: No width-independent teacher-polynomial sample upper or exponential-depth sample lower for original canonical tanh is established.
lean_status: No new theorem in this package is Lean verified.
